Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE SQUARE coherent static scene for taking an unmelted reference core from buried Martian ice and putting it in compact cold storage. FIRST reference supplies the SAME soft cream pressure-fabric habitat architecture, exposed narrow arched ribs, warm light and open-leg lightweight table style. SECOND reference supplies the exact SMALL cream/teal sealed well head and near-well water processor, TWO insulated hoses and dry rusty plain. Do not copy its 2x2 layout: this must be one single view.
View from INSIDE the habitat at an angle. LEFT half x .06-.47: a tall rounded teal inner-airlock door frame with a CLOSED clear pressure window. Through it the outer airlock opening reveals a useful unobstructed view of dry red rocky ground outside. Pressure glass is almost invisible, with a slight edge reflection; the indoor room is not vented to Mars. In the lower-middle portion of that exterior view, x .25,y .48, show a recognizable undisturbed shallow-coring patch of fine dusty ground with one tiny survey pin at its edge. No hole or ice is already exposed. Beyond and to the SIDE of this patch, farther in the exterior view around x .37,y .34, the familiar small well head and water processor stand about 15 metres from the habitat. They are modest in the distance and offset from the coring patch; two slim insulated hoses retain the well-to-processor and processor-to-hab paths. The patch is outside the well's disturbed ground. Distant red mesas; absolutely no blue glacier, exposed ice bank, large drill tower, pond or giant machinery.
RIGHT half x .54-.94: a light cream table with thin metal legs and completely open space underneath, matching the first reference. On top is ONE SMALL horizontal refrigerated core cradle, only large enough for a slender ice core. A shallow insulated cream/teal trough with a low clear closed lid, two small internal saddles and one narrow empty liner, not a huge chamber. Tiny connected coolant tubes and a power lead visibly run to a small wall service plate; no gas bottles, storage cabinets, built-in wall freezer, drawers, second table, microscope or extra equipment. Cradle centre x .74,y .43, modest width about .30 of image, tabletop y .55 and legs down to .79. A dark slender ice-core-sized empty space inside makes its purpose readable. The outdoor patch left and cold-storage cradle right are distinct accessible game receivers. Keep quiet bare floor below y .82. Same cream/teal restrained retro hardware, natural scale, realistic painted adventure illustration, warm indoor light balanced with dusty outdoor daylight. No people, text or diagrams.
